question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.constructor_id, MAX(ds.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON d.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND d.year = (SELECT year FROM races WHERE race_id = ds.race_id)
    GROUP BY d.year, d.constructor_id
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as team_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
)
SELECT dp.year, dp.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, 
       dp.best_driver_points, tp.team_points,
       (dp.best_driver_points + tp.team_points) as combined_points
FROM driver_points dp
JOIN team_points tp ON dp.year = tp.year AND dp.constructor_id = tp.constructor_id
JOIN constructors c ON dp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
